rules.statement: V lived through Johnny’s 2023 Arasaka assault memory after the Relic activated.
V lived through Johnny’s 2013 memory of Alt’s abduction and the Arasaka rescue attempt.
V and Johnny reached Alt beyond the Blackwall during Transmission.
V selected Panam for the private farewell call and spoke to her before the final plan.
V asked Panam for Aldecaldo help on the committed final route.
V committed to Panam’s Aldecaldo plan and completed the help call.
V committed to Hanako’s Arasaka plan and completed the help call.
Johnny and Rogue took the Arasaka assault route together; Rogue boarded the AV.
V and Johnny carried the solo Arasaka assault through to Mikoshi.
V reached Mikoshi on the solo assault; the late solo marker is written only after its Mikoshi access branch.
V extracted Hanako from the Arasaka estate and completed Last Caress.
V retained the body after Mikoshi and entered the Star or Sun epilogue.
Johnny retained V’s body and entered the Temperance epilogue.
V returned from Mikoshi and reached the Aldecaldo epilogue with Panam.
V and the Aldecaldos completed the border crossing out of Night City.
Johnny left Night City at the end of New Dawn Fades.
Johnny insulted Kerry during their 2023 farewell after the Samurai show.
V took Johnny’s dog tags during their Tapeworm conversation.
Rogue and Johnny committed to the Arasaka assault and boarded the AV.
Weyland was recovered during Rogue’s Arasaka assault route.
Adam Smasher killed Saul during the Aldecaldo assault, witnessed by V and Panam.
The Aldecaldos agreed on the assault plan with V at their camp.
The Aldecaldo drill opened a route into Arasaka’s underground approach.
V reached and connected to Mikoshi after the Aldecaldo assault.
Panam witnessed V connect to Mikoshi after the Aldecaldo assault.
Panam and V made a plan to leave Night City through an old smuggling tunnel.
Mitch was well enough to join the border convoy and spoke with V before departure.
Judy joined V and the Aldecaldos to leave Night City.
Judy joined V and the Aldecaldos to leave Night City.
Judy told V she would leave Night City instead of staying with V at the Afterlife.
Panam and V took different roads after Mikoshi; Panam left Night City while V stayed for the Afterlife job.
V spoke with a damaged Jackie construct in Arasaka’s tower; this does not restore the deceased Jackie’s continuity.
V chose Hanako’s Arasaka route, and Takemura was alive to accompany the operation.
Takemura joined V for Hanako’s estate extraction on the Arasaka route.
Takemura survived and visited V aboard Arasaka’s orbital station at the final contract decision.
Rogue survived because V reached Mikoshi by the solo route and then entered the Sun epilogue.
Johnny overheard Rogue’s farewell call to her son before their Arasaka AV assault.
Bob and Teddy died during the Aldecaldo construction assault before the group drilled through to Arasaka.
Mitch survived the tower assault and returned to the Aldecaldo border convoy.
Panam was V’s selected romantic partner and they left Night City together on the Aldecaldo route.
Takemura visited V after Arasaka treatment, when V had received the terminal prognosis and faced the final contract decision.
Johnny left the guitar he bought with Steve in Steve’s care when he departed by bus.
Johnny visited V’s memorial after retaining the body on an Aldecaldo or solo route where Rogue survived.
The NetWatch deal led to the Voodoo Boys netrunners’ purge after V and Johnny reached Alt.
V chose Judy as the private rooftop farewell contact and completed the call.
V spoke with Judy from Arasaka orbit; she was angry and preparing to leave Night City.
V spoke with Panam from Arasaka orbit after choosing her as the romantic rooftop contact.
